name: Enzyme
description: Semantic search and pattern discovery for Obsidian vaults — petri (working memory) and catalyze (concept search) over your notes.

vaultPath.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian/markdown vault. If unset, falls back to ENZYME_VAULT_ROOT env var, then the agent's working directory.

binaryPath.description: Path to the enzyme binary. If unset, resolves via PATH.

autoRecall.description: Inject `enzyme petri` context into the prompt before each agent turn.

autoRefresh.description: Run `enzyme refresh --quiet` after each agent turn (requires hooks.allowConversationAccess).

vaultPath.label: Vault path
vaultPath.help: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault.

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall
autoRecall.help: Inject vault context into every prompt.

autoRefresh.label: Auto-refresh
autoRefresh.help: Re-index after each turn. Requires conversation access.
